svg.desc: WFP Regional Office LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT World Food Programme (WFP) COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2017 600,000 Euro DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This office project in Downtown Cairo for the World Food Program (WFP), valued at 600,000 Euro, involved architectural and MEP services. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
